name: Proofday
summary: A bakery rota and people-care app for several shops, with a wellbeing bloom and kudos wall
about: A seven-page app for bakeries, cafés and shops with several sites that plans shifts and looks after the people who work them. It is built from soft raised panels in warm sand with a floating dock. Drag shifts on the week rota while clashes, hours and wages update, record weekly mood check-ins that grow a wellbeing bloom per shop, log 1:1s, give kudos and keep training up to date.
how: Choose a shop (or all) at the top and switch pages from the floating dock at the bottom.
On Home, watch each shop's flower bloom; every petal is a person and longer petals mean a better week. Click a petal for their care card.
On Rota, drag shifts between people and days (Alt copies, M moves with the keyboard), click a slot to add, then copy, fill, clear or publish.
On Care, tap a score to record someone's week, press Send check-in to watch answers come in, and post kudos to the wall.
On Training, click any cell to record a course done today; counts and expiry dates update.
On People, open a care card to see mood history, training and next shifts, log a 1:1 note or edit the person.
